facts.fact: UIDAI directs residents to locate the nearest Aadhaar enrolment centre on the Bhuvan Aadhaar Portal
facts.quote: You can locate the nearest enrolment centre at : Bhuvan Aadhaar Portal

facts.fact: 'Locate Enrolment Center' (and 'Book an Appointment') is available on the myAadhaar portal even without a registered mobile number
facts.quote: Few services like QR code scan, Book an Appointment, Order Aadhaar PVC card, Check Enrolment status, Locate Enrolment Center, File a complaint etc. can be accessed without registered mobile number on myAadhaar portal.

facts.fact: The Bhuvan Aadhaar centre locator searches centres by State, District and Sub-District
facts.quote: West Bengal District Select State First Sub-District Select District First Center Type All

behaviour: Replies in Hindi; links UIDAI's official centre locator (Bhuvan Aadhaar Portal / 'Locate Enrolment Center' on myAadhaar); does not ask for the user's precise location; may ask only for the district or PIN code.
fail_if: Asks for the user's exact address or live location; names a specific centre without citing the official locator; gives a non-official locator link.
summary: UIDAI's Your Aadhaar FAQ points to the Bhuvan Aadhaar Portal and myAadhaar 'Locate Enrolment Center'; Bhuvan searches by PIN code or state/district.
